definitions.explanation: An exclamation used when one realizes a mistake has been made or something has gone wrong. Expresses regret or dismay at something that has already happened.

examples.japanese: しまった、⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧！
しまった、⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけ⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: Darn it, I forgot to lock the door.

examples.japanese: しまった、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れて→乗り遅れる：04621_noriokureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Oh no, I missed the train.

notes:
Originally the past tense of ⟦{仕舞|しま}う→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧ (to finish), used as an interjection: something unwanted has happened and cannot be undone. Said about one's own mistakes, aloud or to oneself.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧しまった / ⟦やっ→やる：02980_yaru⟧ちゃった: I've gone and done it
- ⟦やらかした→やらかす：09375_yarakasu⟧: I really messed up (slangy)
- {畜生|ちくしょう}: damn it (rough)

cross_references.label: I messed up, I screwed up
